summary: This paper is a review article, not a primary experimental study. It discusses and tabulates numerous MXene-based electrodes, but their synthesis routes and electrochemical data are explicitly attributed to previously published references. The review authors did not fabricate or electrochemically characterize any electrodes themselves; therefore, no electrode entries are reported. Performance values in figures, tables, and narrative text were excluded as literature benchmarks rather than original measurements from this paper.
